gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify the mismatch between the stated backward-lag covariance convention and the entries and right-hand side used in the quaternion normal-equation system. The prediction explicitly derives the conjugation reversal and supplies the corrected matrix/system.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The displayed Toeplitz system does not represent the stated linear prediction normal equations because the lag orientation is conjugated incorrectly; the corresponding entries and system must be corrected.

component_coverage.gold_component: The covariance convention makes the normal-equation matrix entries conjugate(eta(s'-s)) on the upper branch, with the opposite branch correspondingly reversed, so the printed matrix is not the stated prediction system.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 derives exactly the conjugation and transpose mismatch in the normal-equation matrix and explains that the displayed system has the wrong unknown/right-hand-side formulation.

component_coverage.gold_component: A corrected entry identification or equivalent corrected system is required.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 gives the specific corrected entry formula and the equivalent corrected right-hand-side system.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that the Fourier block calculation uses the wrong signs and frequency orientation: the conjugated scalar circulant contributes the symbol at -theta, while the off-diagonal sign must be corrected. The resulting displayed blocks are therefore not the actual Hermitian Fourier blocks.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The old Fourier-block construction miscomputes the scalar-circulant symbols and off-diagonal signs, producing non-Hermitian blocks instead of the actual Hermitian blocks needed for the spectral argument.

component_coverage.gold_component: The first-column computation for the off-diagonal circulant gives the opposite sign from the printed -Phi_2 contribution.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-005 identifies the incorrect off-diagonal signs and gives corrected Hermitian blocks with the corresponding sign adjustment.

component_coverage.gold_component: Entrywise conjugation of the phi_1 circulant reverses the Fourier frequency, yielding phi_1(f_m)(-theta_s), not the printed conjugate/value at theta_s.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-005 explicitly states that the conjugated circulant contributes phi_1(f_m)(-2pi s/n) and incorporates that frequency in the corrected block.

component_coverage.gold_component: Because of these symbol and sign errors, the displayed blocks are not the actual Hermitian Fourier blocks and the downstream block-based spectral proof is unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-005 states that the displayed blocks are non-Hermitian and supplies the corrected Hermitian block form with the proper frequency alignment and eigenvalue interpretation.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns an incomplete Fourier-coefficient argument for a function g and the missing use of its purely imaginary symmetry. It does not diagnose the separate PCG obligation that recurrence parameters are real because they are ratios of positive-real HPD quadratic forms, nor the resulting real-coefficient polynomial representation.
